The model applies for $0\le t\le25$.

When full, at $t=0$: $Q(0)=2000(25)^2=1\,250\,000$ L.

solutions.latex:
$\dfrac{dA}{d\theta}=1600\cos2\theta$

Stationary points: $1600\cos2\theta=0$, so $\cos2\theta=0$, so $2\theta=\dfrac\pi2,\dfrac{3\pi}{2},\ldots$, so $\theta=\dfrac\pi4,\dfrac{3\pi}{4},\ldots$

$\theta$ cannot be $\dfrac{3\pi}4$ since $2\theta>\pi$ (angle too large), so $\theta=\dfrac\pi4$.

$\dfrac{d^2A}{d\theta^2}=-3200\sin2\theta$; at $\theta=\dfrac\pi4$, $\dfrac{d^2A}{d\theta^2}=-3200<0$, so the area is a maximum.

Maximum area: $A=800\sin\dfrac\pi2=800$ m$^2$.
solutions.marks_breakdown: 1/2: differentiating $A$; 1/2: finding the stationary point; 1/2: differentiating $A'$; 1/2: proving a maximum at $\theta=\frac\pi4$; 1/2: $A=800\sin2(\frac\pi4)$; 1/2: $A=800$ m$^2$
